purpose: Reproduction failures that have been investigated and are kept as failures. The audit accepts exactly these failed acceptance metrics at these levels; any other failure, or a listed failure that starts passing, fails the audit. Targets and tolerances are never changed here.

failures.finding: About 1.5% above the article in FEMM 5; mesh refinement moves the result further away and the original file gives the same values. Cause unresolved.
The small-ball weighted-stress force changes from -2.5% to +0.06% to +8.3% of the published value as explicit mesh sizes are halved and quartered: not mesh-converged.

At the source's ~1,400-node mesh the cogging torque swings by about 0.1 N*m between adjacent 3-degree samples and changes by about 25% with smart meshing; the published values come from the 2018 sliding-band test build.
